description: Tests first: backfill preservation, no/ambiguous origins, database NOT NULL, ownership and connector validation. Extend existing connector migration and People APIs; PersonIdentities.claim remains ownership owner. Remove legacy ingress binding and automatic profile-email channel creation; update every writer. Migration local-only SQL, not agent-exposed. Docs channels/engine updated. Real DB and property tests, external mocks only.

comments.text: Strict People schema and new backfill migration implemented; profiles/discovery/merges no longer invent unscoped links. New contract/migration tests pass, including actual test-DB migration. Existing tests/fixtures require explicit connector updates; validation remains open. Shared ChannelConfig management query introduced for strict validation. Graph E2E fan-in is intentional: People and notification journeys both precede finalization. No commits/push authorized.

User approved boundary correction and treats migrations absent from main as unconsumed. Verified origin/main: connector-scope and native-identity migrations are unmerged; NormalizePersonEmails exists on main and must remain consumed. Reuse assessment: extend existing CommunicationBridge/Bridge config+delivery seam with connector-owned platform/direction/topic metadata and shared delivery resolution used by preflight+actual delivery; reuse EmailBridge SMTP policy and IncomingMessageRouting persistence. No new Action/tool or parallel notification transport mechanism. Engine/UI receive generic platform/direction/topic metadata only; preserve recipient platform and origin scope. Fold mandatory scope into original scope migration and identity backfill into original identity migration; delete our augmentation migration. Tests: fresh stack/old data replay, exact scope preservation on outgoing/logs, disabled/mismatch/session-only, generic routing topics. No commit/push.

title: [zaq-s04.1] Migration and strict People contracts
